question: Assume today is 2026-04-18. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate China's total retail sales of consumer goods (社会消费品零售总额) for the single month of April 2026 (not the January-April cumulative total), in Chinese yuan (CNY; the release states it in 亿元, i.e. units of 100 million yuan), as it will be first reported in the National Bureau of Statistics of China's monthly release on retail sales of consumer goods.

target.what: China's total retail sales of consumer goods (社会消费品零售总额), single month of April 2026, as first reported by NBS in the monthly release (亿元)
target.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
target.cadence: monthly, with January-February combined; April single-month figure published in the mid-May release
target.caveats: Target period is future relative to cutoff (2026-04-18), so April is only partly observed. NBS reports nominal (current-price) retail sales, not volume; the figure is the first-reported value and may later be revised. Definition covers retail sales of consumer goods by enterprises above and below de

candidates.hypothesis: April 2026 level = April 2025 level × (1 + April 2026 y/y growth). April 2025 single-month value and recent 2025-2026 monthly values anchor the base; seasonal April pattern (post-Q1, pre-May holiday) constrains the level.
candidates.data_to_find: NBS reported 社会消费品零售总额 single-month values for April 2025 and each month from mid-2025 through March 2026 (in 亿元), plus y/y growth rates. Minimum: April 2025 level and March 2026 level/growth.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
